details: Major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and XRP have continued their downward trend. Bitcoin fell below $77,000, pulling back 7% from its May high, while Ethereum retested key support at $2,100. This downturn is attributed to a broad "risk-off" sentiment and significant outflows from US-listed spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), which saw $1 billion in withdrawals last week—the highest since late January. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has dropped sharply to 28, indicating fear in the market.
title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP See Extended Declines Amid Weak Sentiment and ETF Outflows

details: Bitcoin experienced a flash crash, sliding to $76,500 during early Asian trading hours on Monday, erasing all gains since May 1. This sharp drop was triggered by fresh US-Iran tensions after a social media post from former President Trump, leading to widespread forced selling across crypto markets. The event caused $677 million in total crypto liquidations over 24 hours, with $607 million coming from long positions, indicating a severe deleveraging event.
title: Bitcoin Crashes to $76,000 Following Trump's Iran Threat, Triggering $677M in Liquidations

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced its total crypto, cash, and "moonshots" holdings reached $12.6 billion as of May 17, 2026. The company's holdings include 5.28 million ETH tokens, valued at approximately $2,191 per ETH, representing 4.37% of the total ETH supply. Bitmine also reported 4.7 million staked ETH, generating annualized staking revenues of $289 million.
title: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Reports $12.6 Billion in Crypto & Cash Holdings

details: The CLARITY Act, a proposed legislation aimed at providing regulatory clarity for the crypto industry, successfully cleared the Senate Banking Committee last week. The bill is now set to move to the full Senate for a vote later this year. This act is designed to define decentralization, strengthen consumer protection, and address anti-money laundering concerns, which could provide a clearer framework for the crypto industry and traditional finance.
title: CLARITY Act Clears Senate Banking Committee, Moves to Full Senate

details: Michael Saylor's MicroStrategy has once again expanded its Bitcoin reserves, purchasing an additional 24,869 BTC for approximately $2 billion. This brings their total holdings to a significant portion of the overall Bitcoin supply, reinforcing their long-term bullish stance on the digital asset.
title: MicroStrategy Acquires Additional 24,869 BTC for $2 Billion
